nodes.description: Public total supply state variable of ERC20Basic/ERC20, set in the REXEN constructor to INITIAL_SUPPLY.
Boolean flag controlling whether token transfers are allowed; toggled by enableTransfers.
Mapping(address=>uint256) of token balances, mutated by transfer, transferFrom and mint.
Nested mapping of allowances used by approve, increaseApproval, decreaseApproval and transferFrom.
Accumulated wei raised during the token sale, updated in buyTokens.
Total number of tokens allocated during the sale.
Contract owner address; used as sale wallet, mint source and access-control anchor.
Flag indicating if the token sale is active; controlled by startSale/stopSale.
Constant initial supply of 100,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals.
BasicToken.transfer: transfers tokens from msg.sender to _to after onlyPayloadSize(2) and balance checks.
StandardToken.transferFrom: moves tokens using an allowance, reducing allowed[_from][msg.sender].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] to _value.
Returns the remaining allowance between _owner and _spender.
Increases the caller's allowance for _spender by _addedValue.
Decreases the caller's allowance for _spender by _subtractedValue, floored at zero.
Returns balances[_owner].
Payable token sale entry point: computes tokens, mints them, updates weiRaised/tokenAllocated and forwards ETH to the owner wallet.
Converts a wei amount into tokens and rejects purchases exceeding the owner's remaining balance.
Internal pure price table mapping fixed wei amounts to token amounts.
Internal mint that moves _amount from the owner balance to the recipient.
onlyOwner function transferring contract ownership to _newOwner.
onlyOwner function enabling the sale flag.
onlyOwner function disabling the sale flag.
onlyOwner function toggling the transfersEnabled flag.
onlyOwner function that sweeps the ETH balance to the owner and transfers the remaining token balance held by the contract.
Payable fallback that forwards the call to buyTokens(msg.sender).
REXEN constructor: sets totalSupply, owner, initial balance, tokenAllocated and transfersEnabled.
onlyOwner modifier enforcing msg.sender == owner.
onlyPayloadSize modifier asserting the calldata length to protect against short-address attacks.
Untrusted external caller address used for balance checks, allowances and access control.
wallet.transfer(weiAmount) in buyTokens: external ETH send to the owner wallet, executed after state updates.
owner.transfer(address(this).balance) in claimTokens: external ETH send to the owner.
transfer(owner, balance) call inside claimTokens performing an external token transfer to the owner.
Parameter _to of transfer (recipient address).
Parameter _value of transfer (amount of tokens).
Parameter _from of transferFrom (source address).
Parameter _to of transferFrom (recipient address).
Parameter _value of transferFrom (amount of tokens).
Parameter _spender of approve.
Parameter _value of approve (allowance amount).
Parameter _spender of increaseApproval.
Parameter _addedValue of increaseApproval.
Parameter _spender of decreaseApproval.
Parameter _subtractedValue of decreaseApproval.
Parameter _investor of buyTokens (token recipient).
Parameter _weiAmount of validPurchaseTokens.
Parameter _to of mint (mint recipient).
Parameter _amount of mint.
Parameter _newOwner of changeOwner.
Parameter _transfersEnabled of enableTransfers.
Parameter _owner of balanceOf.
Local weiAmount = msg.value in buyTokens.
Local tokens returned by validPurchaseTokens in buyTokens.
Local wallet = owner in buyTokens; recipient of the external ETH transfer.
Local oldValue snapshot of the allowance in decreaseApproval.
Local addTokens result of getTotalAmountOfTokens in validPurchaseTokens.
Local amountOfTokens computed by the price table in getTotalAmountOfTokens.
Local balance = balanceOf(this) used in claimTokens for the token sweep.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the source account for the balance check and balance subtraction in transfer.
msg.sender indexes allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written by approve.
msg.sender indexes the allowance updated by increaseApproval.
msg.sender indexes the allowance updated by decreaseApproval.
msg.sender is passed to buyTokens from the fallback and used to gate the sale.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner to grant privileged access.
transfer requires transfersEnabled to be true.
transferFrom requires transfersEnabled to be true.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender] and balances[_to].
transfer updates the balances mapping with sub/add operations.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom updates balances[_from] and balances[_to].
increaseApproval adds to allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
decreaseApproval sets or subtracts from allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
allowance reads allowed[_owner][_spender].
balanceOf returns balances[_owner].
The payable fallback invokes buyTokens(msg.sender), which performs an external ETH transfer.
buyTokens calls validPurchaseTokens(weiAmount) to compute the token amount.
validPurchaseTokens calls getTotalAmountOfTokens(_weiAmount).
getTotalAmountOfTokens returns the token amount consumed by validPurchaseTokens.
validPurchaseTokens compares the computed amount against balances[owner].
validPurchaseTokens returns the token amount used by buyTokens.
tokenAllocated is emitted in the TokenLimitReached event inside validPurchaseTokens.
buyTokens calls mint(_investor, tokens, owner).
buyTokens reads owner into wallet and uses it as the mint source.
buyTokens accumulates weiRaised with the received msg.value.
buyTokens accumulates tokenAllocated with the minted amount.
buyTokens performs wallet.transfer(weiAmount), an external ETH send to a stored owner address after minting.
mint reads balances[_owner] and balances[_to].
mint updates the balances mapping with sub/add operations.
claimTokens uses owner as the ETH and token sweep recipient.
claimTokens performs owner.transfer(address(this).balance), an external ETH send.
claimTokens calls transfer(owner, balance) after the ETH transfer, an external token state interaction.
claimTokens calls balanceOf(this) to size the token sweep.
changeOwner is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
startSale is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
stopSale is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
enableTransfers is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
claimTokens is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transfer uses the onlyPayloadSize(2) modifier.
transferFrom uses the onlyPayloadSize(3) modifier.
allowance uses the onlyPayloadSize(2) modifier.
changeOwner overwrites the owner state variable.
startSale sets saleToken to true.
stopSale sets saleToken to false.
enableTransfers overwrites transfersEnabled.
Constructor sets totalSupply to INITIAL_SUPPLY.
Constructor reads INITIAL_SUPPLY for the initial mint.
Constructor assigns the owner address.
Constructor writes balances[owner] = INITIAL_SUPPLY.
Constructor sets transfersEnabled = true.
_to is the transfer recipient.
_value is the transferred amount in transfer.
_from is the source account in transferFrom.
_to is the recipient account in transferFrom.
_value is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
_spender is the allowance grantee in approve.
_value is the allowance amount in approve.
_spender is the allowance grantee in increaseApproval.
_addedValue is added to the allowance in increaseApproval.
_spender is the allowance grantee in decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue is subtracted from the allowance in decreaseApproval.
_investor is the token recipient in buyTokens.
_weiAmount is priced in validPurchaseTokens.
_to is the mint recipient in mint.
_amount is the minted amount in mint.
_newOwner becomes the new owner in changeOwner.
_transfersEnabled is written to the transfersEnabled flag.
_owner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
weiAmount holds msg.value inside buyTokens.
tokens holds the priced token amount inside buyTokens.
wallet is the recipient address of the external ETH transfer in buyTokens.
oldValue caches the current allowance in decreaseApproval.
addTokens holds the priced amount in validPurchaseTokens.
amountOfTokens holds the price-table result in getTotalAmountOfTokens.
balance is the token amount passed to transfer(owner, balance) in claimTokens.
